name: @autonomos/app
description: autonomOS Desktop — native Electron app wrapping the autonomos-server

scripts.build:dmg: bun run prep:resources && bun run build:main && electron-builder --mac dmg --publish never

//comment_no_workspace_deps: Intentionally no workspace deps. The autonomos-server bundle is copied into extraResources/server/ at build time by scripts/electron-before-build.sh — NOT imported as a Node module. Adding @autonomos/server here would make electron-builder try to rebuild node-pty against Electron's ABI, which fails because (a) we ship the .node files prebuilt for plain Node and (b) node-gyp can't rebuild on Python 3.12+.
